locations.name: Palace of the Last Star
locations.basicInfo:
Beneath a fault north of White Echo Escarpment, a stair descends through pale stone into a palace whose roof resembles a sky after its last star has faded. Silver lines cross the dark vault. Some end in clean breaks; others pass behind walls of translucent mineral. In the outer hall, a figure in smoke-blue robes receives those who have found the stair. He calls the place an inheritance left for cultivators patient enough to understand a difficult art.

The approach lies on the plateau itself, reached along the escarpment's northern ground ledge. It neither crosses Still Weight Hollow nor ascends to Heaven-Reaching Altar. The seam is hidden by folded mineral plates. A careful survey reveals worked steps and an ordinary movable counterweight; finding them requires observation and time, not an immortal's cultivation. Beyond the vestibule, calm chambers contain genuine lessons in settling spiritual currents and recovering an interrupted circulation. Farther inward, closed gates bear warnings against opening an exposed star furnace.

The palace is not a public destination. Its location can be learned through an actual survey, a preserved route rubbing passed by someone who has found it, or a deliberate follow-up to unusual worked stone at White Echo Escarpment. The great halls beneath the plateau have room for long study, disagreement and quiet meals brought in from the world above.
